pilot.method: Envelope of complete OSM footprints for seven exact-name matches; 50 m geodesic outward margin, rounded outward to 6 decimals. Acquisition selection only; no geometry clipped.

crs_recommendation.name: NAD83 / UTM zone 18N
crs_recommendation.area_of_use:
- name: North America - between 78°W and 72°W - onshore and offshore. Canada - Nunavut; Ontario; Quebec. United States (USA) - Connecticut; Delaware; Maryland; Massachusetts; New Hampshire; New Jersey; New York; North Carolina; Pennsylvania; Virginia; Vermont.
- bounds: (-78.0, 28.28, -72.0, 84.0)
crs_recommendation.rationale: Pilot is within UTM zone 18N; meter coordinates align with NYS service and standard USGS DEM headers. Native inputs untouched.
crs_recommendation.datum_caution: OSM WGS84 and NAD83 realizations are not survey-equivalent. USGS project metadata may specify NAD83(2011) while standard raster says NAD83. Future processing must record actual PROJ operation, accuracy, grids and vertical datum separately; no invented datum precision.
crs_recommendation.vertical_reference: NAVD88 meters per USGS metadata; not an ellipsoidal height.

raw_policy: New files created during acquisition only; all now immutable. Download response bodies preserved without GIS changes. HTTP content decoding may remove transfer compression. No geometry exported/reprojected.
integrity: SHA256SUMS.txt covers every raw file except itself, including this manifest, request sidecars, queries, and .gitkeep.
metadata_caveat: Use tile-specific USGS XML temporal extent 20190104–20200925. The API vendorMetaUrl chooses Block 1, which does not establish RPI flight dates or accuracy. Hudson vendor XML has blank measured-accuracy fields.
automation_status: All requested core datasets acquired automatically; no access restrictions bypassed. Initial NYS county query used wrong field and returned HTTP API error; corrected to NAME using layer schema. EPSG website returned 403 through browser; recommendation uses local PROJ/EPSG database plus source CRS metadata.
